heroHeadline: AFC/M23 Captures Humura in Masisi as Ebola Deaths Pass 3,175 and Fighting Widens Across Walikale and Kalehe
heroSubtitle: AFC/M23 took the Humura commercial center in Masisi on Sept 6-7 and pressed toward Walikale, extending a week of fighting that also flared at Kisimba (Walikale) and Chinono (Kalehe) and drove fresh displacement toward Kyumba and Langira. DRC's Ebola outbreak passed 3,000 deaths on Sept 2 and stood at 3,175 deaths among 6,604 confirmed cases by Sept 6 — the country's deadliest epidemic on record. MONUSCO's new chief James Swan met President Kagame in Kigali Sept 2 amid a dispute over FDLR repatriation verification, while AFC coordinator Nangaa said the Doha process remains "not dead" despite accusing Kinshasa of stalling.
